name: nest-triangles
description: Sixteen right-triangle gussets, 600mm x 400mm, cut on a CNC router. The point of the fixture is that two of them tile their own bounding box exactly: one square, one turned a half turn, hypotenuse to hypotenuse. A table saw cannot do that - it charges each triangle the whole 600 x 400 box, fits 4 across and 3 down at a 3mm kerf, and so needs 12 boxes per sheet and two sheets for sixteen. A router pairs them into 8 boxes, which fit on one sheet with room to spare. Hand-checked: 4 x 3 boxes per sheet either way, 1 triangle per box on a saw against 2 on a router.
